title: 1808 Prairie shows its own age: eighteen years of weather
items: 1808 Prairie is the first house to weather by its own age. Built in 1886, it has stood eighteen years by July 1904.
Its stone front now darkens at the foot and under the eaves. Faint streaks run down from every window sill and behind each downpipe.
The brick side and rear walls read lighter than before. They had worn the grime of a forty-year-old wall.
